snippet.title: Relicfall - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Relicfall on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4357240/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=steam_page_reveal&utm_content=reveal_trailer_description

Relicfall is a Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite focused on deep character building, powerful synergies, and ARPG-inspired loot.

Choose 3 professions to forge your class, shape a unique skill tree, discover powerful equipment, and socket support relics into your abilities to make them chain, pierce, fork, explode, and more.

Coming Q3 2027 on PC/Steam.
